core_statement: This audit does not estimate real CE29 FDR and does not label real identities as true or false. It tests whether low-confidence identity assignments exhibit stable library-internal replacement geometry consistent with the known false-assignment mechanism observed under synthetic spectral mismatch.
purpose: Describe continuous library-internal molecular deletion/replacement geometry and its limits before deciding whether competitive decoy assignment merits a separately authorized experiment.
publication_gate: Commit and successfully push this contract, protocol, code and source provenance before running source/preflight or any new diagnostic fit. Record the pushed commit in an execution receipt; never rewrite this contract after outcomes.

source_rules.inventory: Only explicitly named files and their direct manifest references; no recursive historical/archive scan.
source_rules.external_asset_commits: Use null when no asset Git commit exists, and identify the immutable hash-binding evidence commit; never invent a source commit.
source_rules.a_choice: CE29 uses the original exported A_calibrated from the completed comparison, with no renormalization. Raw A_library is a separate provenance/physical-mapping input. V58 uses its exact cached A_solver. These two source matrices need not be byte-identical.
source_rules.mask_handling: Source mask is independently verified before averaging; do not duplicate a mask in diagnostic_inputs.npz.
source_rules.v58_target_and_cube: Record original A_target/B_cube/X_true hash declarations as provenance-only where arrays are unavailable. Do not claim local verification, regenerate them, or use target spectra/truth in fitting. The exact cached A/b and attached records are the executable inputs.

units.identity_order: First occurrence in the immutable candidate order; alias lists retain candidate order.
units.mapping: Exact original candidate-to-lipid_name mapping; no new sn/isomer/adduct merging.
units.edge: Directed molecular identity j -> k; k is another library identity, never a CE29 false label.
units.report_gate: Candidate foreground float64 mean > 0.001; molecular reported iff at least one alias is reported.
units.production_abundance: Molecular production reporting abundance is the sum of reported-alias foreground means. Preserve all-alias means/totals as separately labelled descriptive columns; never silently interchange them.
units.diagnostic_abundance: For new full/delete mean-spectrum fits, aggregate all alias coefficients of a molecular identity before computing change; no reporting-gate truncation.

current_confidence.name: existing simulated DEV10 transfer
current_confidence.source_rule: Use existing solver-specific current_records; preserve separate ISTA and NNLS retained/rejected/unreported outcomes and original scores. DEV10 is a threshold name, not a CE29 error guarantee.

contexts.diagnostic_context_order: CE29_GLOBAL; CE29_BLOCK_000 through CE29_BLOCK_063 in order; V58_MILD_CAL_R1_K125; V58_MILD_CAL_R2_K125
contexts.ce29_global: Float64 arithmetic mean over all 15837 original foreground pixels, on all channels.
contexts.ce29_spatial_blocks: Reuse the original NNLS foreground-order partition: consecutive chunks of 250 foreground positions, with final block 87 pixels, exactly 64 blocks. Verify original cache start/stop membership. Means use each block's unchanged B; no spatial repartition or outcome-based block choice.
contexts.normalization: No new normalization, weighting, per-block scaling or rescaling of A or b.
contexts.v58: Two exact already exposed CAL foreground-mean caches, all391 columns. No regenerated observations or pixel maps. No V58 block-stability claim.
contexts.spectral_block_secondary: Hash-verify and reuse all34 existing spectral-fold full/delete caches as a separate secondary result. Their held-out spectral-channel objective is not spatial-block full-channel NNLS; never combine denominators, residuals or edges across these definitions.

solver.kind: New CPU NNLS deletion diagnostic only; production outputs remain immutable.
solver.primitive: Reuse the existing NNLS primitive and KKT verification from analysis/run_nnls_solver_baseline.py and analysis/run_small_mismatch_nnls_first_case.py; no change to solver, tolerances or objective.
solver.precision: float64 for full/deleted coefficients, observations, objective, residuals and saved diagnostic arrays
solver.full: One fit with all391 columns per context.
solver.deletion: For every one of377 molecular identities remove all its alias columns, fit every remaining original column, and pad the removed entries with exact zeros. Identical A values, b, normalization and objective within each full/delete pair.
solver.zero_coefficient_reuse: Only if every source alias in full solution is EXACTLY zero: full optimum remains feasible after deletion and is therefore also a deletion optimum. Reuse full coefficients with removed entries zero, record proof status, and recheck original KKT conditions on every allowed column. No approximately-zero shortcut.
solver.forbidden_pruning: No active-set, reported-set, class, nearest-neighbor, truth-aware or cost-driven candidate-universe pruning.
solver.absolute_necessity: M_j = q_deleted_j - q_full; preserve signed value and numerical status; do not hide materially negative objective differences.
solver.retention: Preserve diagnostic_inputs.npz and all67 context NPZs in diagnostics/{context}.npz, with float64 full/delete coefficient arrays, residual/objective/KKT data or exactly reconstructible bindings and per-identity reuse status. Save hashes and membership in receipts; no deletion.

geometry.identity_direction: Normalize each candidate column to unit L2 norm; take equal-weight mean across a molecular identity's alias columns; L2-normalize that mean. This fixed direction is for geometry only, not a replacement for physical candidate contributions in fitting/attribution.
geometry.occupancy: Number of distinct molecular identities with any positive original A support on channel f; aliases count once.
geometry.reduced_cosine: Divide every channel of each molecular geometry direction by sqrt(max(occupancy_f,1)), then L2-renormalize and compute cosine. This deterministic shared-channel downweighting is not a hardcoded biochemical diagnostic-fragment rule.
geometry.neighbors: Save nearest and top5 under full cosine and reduced cosine separately, same/cross-class nearest, shared fragment intersection count, and shared fraction as intersection/union. Ties use original identity order and carry a tie flag.
geometry.fragment_mapping: Use the existing physical component/channel metadata and parent-versus-fragment masks, retaining original rule_sheet/channel/formula labels. Do not invent class or acyl-chain rules; mark unsupported biochemical classifications DIAGNOSTIC_RULE_NOT_VERIFIED.
geometry.specific_channels: This identity's fragment-support channels with full-A molecular occupancy exactly one. Count other identities' precursor as well as fragment support in occupancy so precursor overlap cannot be called exclusive. This is statistical channel exclusivity, not proof of structural or biochemical specificity.
geometry.common_channels: This identity's fragment-support channels with full-A molecular occupancy greater than one; statistical shared support does not establish class-diagnostic status.
geometry.support_sum: For each common/specific support set F, support=sum(f in F) b_f in unchanged observation units, without normalization. Preserve support-set count and explicit zero-count/NA fraction status.
geometry.support_statistics: Save common/specific support, counts, observed fractions and contribution attribution with explicit formulas/units; retain the unchanged production observation threshold when a verified observation rule exists, otherwise mark formal observed_fraction unavailable rather than create an empirical detection cutoff.
geometry.positive_B_fraction_secondary: For a stated support set F, count(f in F with b_f>0)/len(F); empty F is NA. This secondary positive-observed-value statistic is not detection evidence, a verified observation threshold, or a replacement for formal specific_fragment_observed_fraction.
geometry.attribution: For solver/context and channel f, numerator_jf = sum_{c in aliases(j)} x_c A_fc; denominator_f = sum_c x_c A_fc + 1e-12. attr_jf = numerator_jf/denominator_f. Use actual candidate columns and abundances; never an unweighted molecular geometry direction.
geometry.attribution_summaries: Arithmetic mean and maximum on each stated support set; specific-support attribution is arithmetic mean on specific channels. Empty sets are NA with zero count, not fabricated zero evidence.

redistribution.molecular_change: delta_x_k_given_j = sum_{c in aliases(k)} x_deleted_j_c - sum_{c in aliases(k)} x_full_c
redistribution.fraction: p_k_given_j = g_k_given_j/(C_j + 1e-12); save top1/top5 identity, gain and fraction, plus all-edge continuous values.
redistribution.numerical_edge_tolerance: tau_j = 64 * finfo(float64).eps * max(A.shape) * max(1, max(x_full), max(x_deleted_j)); compute separately for each source deletion row and context, not using the maximum over the entire deleted-coefficient matrix
redistribution.presence: Edge exists numerically iff g_k_given_j > tau. Keep raw gains unchanged. This tolerance only distinguishes numerical edges and unique-top ties; it is not a confidence or biological cutoff.
redistribution.unique_top: Largest gain must exceed tau and exceed second-largest gain by more than tau; ties are unresolved, not arbitrarily stable.
redistribution.interpretation: Redistribution is an allocation response in an alternative fitted model, not an error rate, causal identity replacement or necessarily conserved mass.

residuals.sign: r_full = b - A x_full; r_deleted_j = b - A x_deleted_j; delta_r_j = r_deleted_j - r_full
residuals.residual_absorption: cos(r_deleted_j, a_k) with unit molecular geometry direction a_k; save signed value.
residuals.delta_residual_absorption: cos(delta_r_j, a_k); main residual-direction summary, saved alongside residual_absorption.
residuals.cosine_denominator: dot(u,v)/(norm(u)*norm(v)+1e-12); additionally flag numerically vanishing directions so tiny norms are not interpreted as evidence.
residuals.kkt_caveat: At a valid NNLS optimum, active retained-column residual projections are approximately zero by KKT, and inactive ones are nonpositive under b-Ax convention. Near-zero absorption cannot establish absent competition; delta-residual projections are also optimum-constrained. Report these limits prominently.
residuals.replacement_signal: h_j = sum_{c not in aliases(j)} A_fc*max(0,x_deleted_j_c-x_full_c)
residuals.signal_projection: Report cos(s_j,h_j) and dot(s_j,h_j)/(dot(s_j,s_j)+1e-12) separately as removed-signal/replacement-signal alignment; never rename it residual absorption or silently substitute it for the prescribed residual metrics.
residuals.old_cache_sign: Old cal_rho_numerical_diagnostic stores A x-b, not b-Ax, and lacks full redistribution coefficients; it is provenance/limited secondary evidence only.

solver_and_spatial_agreement.support: Save reported_by_both, ista_only, nnls_only, neither; one-sided report membership is SOLVER_SUPPORT_DISAGREEMENT without an arbitrary ratio cutoff.
solver_and_spatial_agreement.continuous: Molecular foreground means/totals, Pearson, Spearman/rank correlation, report-set Jaccard/counts, ratio/log ratio where defined, per-identity pixelwise Pearson and spatial cosine. Undefined zero denominators or constant vectors are NA with status.
solver_and_spatial_agreement.spatial_maps: Use original saved ISTA and full-library NNLS foreground maps, aggregated by fixed molecular aliases, with production reported-alias summaries distinguished from all-alias maps.
solver_and_spatial_agreement.overlap: For each stated solver save spatial cosine, Pearson, positive-support intersection/union and abundance-weighted overlap sum(min(map_j,map_k))/(sum(max(map_j,map_k))+1e-12); no spatial selection rule.
solver_and_spatial_agreement.ista_edges: No legal molecular-deletion ISTA edge cache is available. Do not retrain or emulate one. ista_edge_present, same_top_replacement, top5 overlap, redistribution rank correlation and solver edge agreement are NA/ISTA_DELETION_UNAVAILABLE, not false/zero/PASS.
solver_and_spatial_agreement.solver_dependent_edge: Use SOLVER_DEPENDENT_EDGE only when comparable edges were actually evaluated under both solvers and disagree; unavailable ISTA edges do not establish solver dependence.

block_stability.eligible: Source molecular full-fit abundance exceeds that deletion/context numerical tolerance; all64 original blocks are accounted for. Do not discard an eligible block for having no replacement, a tie, low gain or inconvenient absorption.
block_stability.edge_presence_fraction: Number of eligible blocks with numerical edge j->k / eligible block count.
block_stability.top_replacement_consistency: Number of eligible blocks where k is the unique top replacement / eligible block count. Tied/no-replacement blocks stay in denominator.
block_stability.strict_stable: At least2 eligible blocks and the same unique top replacement k in EVERY eligible block. This is a deliberately strict descriptive stability definition, not a GO threshold.
block_stability.presence_persistent: At least2 eligible blocks for source j and numerical edge j->k present in EVERY eligible block, using the identical per-source/context tau and source-eligibility denominator. The edge need not be top-ranked. Preserve this indicator separately from strict_stable; multiple persistent edges per source are allowed.
block_stability.rank_stability: Pairwise Spearman correlation of complete replacement-gain vectors across eligible blocks; summarize median/IQR and valid pair count; constant-vector correlations are NA.
block_stability.absorption: Signed residual and delta-residual absorption median/IQR over eligible blocks, with finite/nonzero-direction counts.
block_stability.zero_denominator: Eligible count zero gives NA and NOT_EVALUABLE, never stability zero or one.

graph.edges: Unique directed union of numerical CE29 replacement edges appearing in GLOBAL or any of the64 spatial blocks, excluding V58. competition_edges.csv and competition_graph_edges.csv use the same union and edge-count denominator. Preserve global presence, block presence/frequency, global gain/fraction, residual metrics and strict stability separately; block-only edges may have zero global gain and are explicitly flagged.
graph.stable_pair: Unordered identity pair supporting at least one strict-stable directed edge; also report reciprocal stable pairs separately.
graph.clique: Construct an undirected pair only when both j->k and k->j are presence_persistent, with each direction evaluated on its own unchanged eligible-block denominator. Enumerate maximal cliques of size>=3 in this reciprocal presence-persistent graph. stable_clique_count, largest_clique_size and clique coverage refer explicitly to presence-persistent cliques, not unique-top cliques. No transitive closure pretending all pairs were observed.
graph.clique_definition_rationale: Frozen before outcomes: a reciprocal unique-top graph gives each node at most one neighbor and cannot contain a clique of size>=3. Presence persistence is therefore the prespecified separate diagnostic for multi-identity confusion sets; strict-stable edge and stable-pair definitions remain unchanged. No numerical threshold or eligibility denominator is altered.
graph.entropy: For each source with positive total gain, H_j = -sum_k (g_k/C_j)*log(g_k/C_j); otherwise NA. Save raw and normalized entropy where at least2 positive replacements exist.
graph.concentration: Per-source top1/top5 replacement fractions and incoming gain/count concentration; retain empirical distributions.
graph.metadata: Same-class/adduct/rule_sheet use exact source metadata/set overlap with NA if absent; precursor distance is minimum absolute distance over source/replacement alias precursor m/z values.

anchors.purpose: Descriptive internal consistency profiles only; never ground truth, labels for training or new selected candidates.
anchors.eligible: Reported by both ISTA and NNLS and all four anchor metrics finite.
anchors.quantiles: Compute q25 and q75 once within the eligible set using numpy linear quantiles, with inclusive comparisons; save boundaries before assigning profiles.
anchors.strong: agreement>=q75 AND R>=q75 AND nearest_cosine<=q25 AND specific_attribution>=q75
anchors.weak: agreement<=q25 AND R<=q25 AND nearest_cosine>=q75 AND specific_attribution<=q25
anchors.ties: If an identity satisfies both due to collapsed quantiles, label unresolved rather than both anchors; report tie counts.
anchors.empty: If no clear disjoint strong and weak profile remains, report NO_CLEAR_INTERNAL_EVIDENCE_GRADIENT. Never relax quantiles or metric availability to manufacture anchors.

v58_comparison.geometrical_parity: Identical all391-column molecular definitions, full-spectrum/reduced cosine, full/delete SSE, redistribution, residual metrics, specific support and global-mean geometry formulas. Use the source-specific frozen A for each domain.
v58_comparison.truth: Use frozen molecular_truth only after geometry computation for original reported TP/FP strata; unreported truth stays labelled separately. No truth-aware deletion universe, edge choice, threshold or anchor tuning.
v58_comparison.ce29_strata: Separate original solver-specific retained/rejected reported identities and disjoint descriptive strong/weak profiles. Never equate rejected with FP.
v58_comparison.independence: Report R1/R2 separately and label any pooled repeated-identity summary descriptive; neither provides independent biological replicates or a CE29 risk guarantee.
v58_comparison.similarity_decision: Assess convergent effect directions/distribution overlap across the prespecified mechanisms and record disagreements; no p-value-only or post-hoc numerical similarity cutoff. Missing geometry/stability stays explicit.

decision.evidence_limit: Missing comparable ISTA deletion edges limits Q1 to PARTIAL/NO and Q3 to PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED/NOT_SUPPORTED. Do not claim cross-solver stable geometry. Insufficient V58 similarity evidence is Q2 PARTIAL with explicit unresolved status, not affirmative similarity.
decision.routing: Choose conservatively from observed source support, continuous geometry, replacement stability and missing evidence. A pure COMPETITIVE_DECOY_ASSIGNMENT recommendation requires solver-consistent competition evidence and is unavailable in this audit. Use MIXED_STRATIFIED_ROUTE only for a documented limited subset; otherwise prioritize the demonstrated solver or experimental-evidence gap, or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. No numerical GO threshold is introduced.
decision.coverage: Save full nearest-cosine/residual-absorption CDFs, strict-stable edge fraction, same/cross-class stable fractions, separately named presence-persistent edge counts/fractions and reciprocal presence-persistent clique coverage, plus solver-consistent-edge availability; unavailable fractions are NA, not zero.

outputs: necessary execution/input/output hash receipts and exact descriptive CDF/secondary-cache tables

required: exact candidate order and377 molecular grouping
all64 original spatial blocks and15837 foreground pixels
zero shortcut exactness and all-allowed-column KKT
independent objective and signed residual reconstruction
CE29 has no TP/FP/FDR/recall truth fields
all diagnostic arrays preserved and hashed
validation.review: Independent review script reads original inputs and saved diagnostic arrays, reconstructs key metrics without refitting, and does not import the producer geometry calculations.
validation.completion: Only after independent PASS: save requested outputs, update CURRENT_STATE/NEXT_TASK, commit and successfully push the exact result snapshot, verify inclusion, then STOP.

prohibited: change ISTA/NNLS/rho implementations or frozen scientific settings
new simulation or raw MSI processing
change CE uncertainty or existing thresholds
